caseName: Riley v. International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America, Local Union No. 633
caseNameFull: Riley, Labor Commissioner v. International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America, Local Union No. 633
attorneys: Ernest R. D’Amours, Attorney General of New Hampshire, for petitioners. H. Thornton Lorimer for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. It appearing that the cause has become moot, the judgment of the Supreme Court of New Hampshire is vacated without costs and the cause is remanded for such proceedings as by that Court may be deemed appropriate.
